about: Get a visa to complete the 10-year Golden Residence process as a graduate of an accredited UAE university.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Golden Residence visa for graduates of UAE universities. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: University must be rated A or B by the Ministry of Education
Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Bachelor's, master's or doctorate from a university accredited and licensed by the Ministry of Education
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS) or ICP Smart App
